title: Lumi and the Lost Bunny
audience: English language learners in primary school

scenes.title: LOST IN THE WOODS
scenes.narration: One evening, Lumi the firefly saw a little bunny crying in the forest.

scenes.title: A LITTLE PROBLEM
scenes.narration: I am lost, said Ben. I cannot find my way home.

scenes.title: FOLLOW THE LIGHT
scenes.narration: Lumi smiled. Follow my tiny light. We can find the path together.

scenes.title: A BRAVE JOURNEY
scenes.narration: They crossed a stream and walked past the tall trees.

scenes.title: HOME AT LAST
scenes.narration: At last, Ben saw his cozy home. Thank you, Lumi!

scenes.title: A BIG LESSON
scenes.narration: Even a small light can make a big difference. The end.
